item.title: Lago (YC S21) Is Hiring for Our GTM Team
Microsoft Can Track Users via a Windows Device ID
item.description:
📝 The 39-page criminal complaint shows the FBI used Microsoft records to discover that his IP address was associated with a Microsoft device identifier known as Global Device ID (GDID). (Credit: DOJ) Hence, the fact that federal investigators used the Microsoft identifier to nab a suspected hacker is raising concerns that it could be abused for other surveillance purposes. "Very likely it’s not unique to Microsoft.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pcmag.com/news/a-hackers-arrest-reveals-microsoft-can-track-users-via-a-windows-device

item.title: NSA and IETF: Fairness
item.description:
📝 Issuing an RFC means issuing IETF endorsement of solo ML-KEM in TLS. Presumably the next step after RFCs on solo ML-KEM and solo ML-DSA in TLS is that NSA will keep spending money to encourage broader deployment of solo ML-KEM and solo ML-DSA. This vote on solo ML-KEM says it "ends 2026-07-08".
🔗 Read more: https://blog.cr.yp.to/20260706-fairness.html
